issues.description: Module lesson_ids arrays are empty, leaving the lessons orphaned from the module outline.

technical_review.notes: Similar to review-002, the lessons are fully defined but missing from the course outline's module arrays [cite: 6].

special_question.answer: Yes. The design is a rigorous and detailed approach to technical communication.
special_question.notes: The explicit inclusion of a 'domain-informed evaluator' for factual accuracy highlights a sophisticated understanding of the limits of automated assessment in technical writing [cite: 6].

rubric_scores.rationale: Success criteria are highly detailed, though relying on a human 'domain-informed evaluator' makes it less scalable [cite: 6].
Assessments precisely map to the conditions and criteria of the objectives [cite: 6].
The requirement that adapted text must not introduce factual inaccuracies is a critical and highly valid evidence bar for this skill [cite: 6].
Analysis of audience directly supports the application of structural and terminological adaptations [cite: 6].
The prerequisites are granular (e.g., distinguishing specialist vocabulary) and map perfectly to the cognitive requirements [cite: 6].
The linear progression from audience analysis to structure to terminology is highly coherent [cite: 6].
The lessons use independent practice and guided questions effectively to build up to the summative tasks [cite: 6].
Time budgeting is tight (12 mins for independent practice of structuring), but the scaffolding is strong [cite: 6].
Technical fixes required for module arrays, but pedagogical structure is sound.

prerequisite_acceptance.notes: The prerequisites are well-defined and accurately isolate the entry knowledge needed [cite: 6].

edit_effort.notes: Link the lesson IDs into the module definitions.

pedagogical_review.overall_notes: A very rigorous design that accurately acknowledges the complexities of evaluating technical adaptations for factual accuracy [cite: 6].
